name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-external-sharing-sensitive-review
title: External Sharing and Sensitive Content Review
shortDescription: A bounded, read-only SharePoint Framework web part for reviewing external sharing and sensitive-content indicators.
longDescription: This sample provides a read-only review aid for SharePoint lists and libraries.
It identifies external or guest sharing, broad sharing links, sensitive-content indicators, unique permissions, missing governance metadata, and stale review dates from available SharePoint fields.
The review is bounded to four sources, five pages, and 200 rows per source and uses SharePoint REST GET requests only.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page. Client-side web parts can be deployed to SharePoint environments that support the SharePoint Framework.
